package tag

import (
	"context"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// CreateTagInput holds create data.
type CreateTagInput struct {
	Name string
	Slug string
}

// CreateTag creates a tag or returns existing by slug.
type CreateTag struct {
	Tags repository.TagRepository
}

// Handle creates or returns existing tag.
func (uc CreateTag) Handle(ctx context.Context, in CreateTagInput) (domain.Tag, error) {
	existing, err := uc.Tags.GetBySlug(ctx, in.Slug)
	if err != nil && err != domain.ErrNotFound {
		return domain.Tag{}, err
	}
	if existing != nil {
		return *existing, nil
	}
	tag := domain.Tag{
		Name:      in.Name,
		Slug:      in.Slug,
		CreatedAt: time.Now().UTC(),
	}
	if err := uc.Tags.Create(ctx, tag); err != nil {
		return domain.Tag{}, err
	}
	created, err := uc.Tags.GetBySlug(ctx, in.Slug)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.Tag{}, err
	}
	if created == nil {
		return domain.Tag{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return *created, nil
}
